主要内容: On September 21, 2017, Insperity, Inc. (NYSE: NSP) appointed Ellen Masterson to its Board of Directors. She was named a Class I director with an initial term expiring in 2020 and joined the Finance, Risk Management, and Audit Committee. Ms. Masterson received a pro rata share of the $105,000 Annual Director Award. No transactions under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K were reported. Ellen Masterson, who retired as a partner with PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP in 2008, has also served as an independent director of Westwood Holdings Group (NYSE: WHG) and Westwood Trust since 2014. She chairs the audit committee of both entities and is a member of the WHG governance committee. Her expertise includes audits of financial services companies and public firms focused on mergers and acquisitions.
